title: NEON CITY CYBERPUNK RIG
description: A massive, fully rigged, modular cyberpunk character mesh with custom glowing wireframes and low-poly optimization for Unity HDRP.
body:
### Challenge
The client needed a photorealistic humanoid asset that could run on mobile platforms without sacrificing the high-definition neon subsurface scattering materials. The polygon count had to be strictly under 15,000 tris.

### Solution
We engineered a robust custom shader pipeline combined with a baked texture workflow, reducing draw calls by 80% while retaining the glowing emission maps.

### Results
- 15k Tri Limit Respected
- 60 FPS on Mobile
- Custom Shaders Built

### Technologies Used
- Blender
- Unity HDRP
- Substance Painter

### Client
Void Interactive Games
